rationale: The plan correctly refuses to re-fit any count model and starts from the supplied DESeq2 table, ranking every tested gene by the Wald statistic with a named fallback, an explicit NA-drop policy and a duplicate-symbol resolution rule, then runs gseapy.prerank against a named, versioned human Hallmark GMT with a 15-500 size window, 10000 permutations, a fixed seed and BH adjustment - exactly the reference approach, with no pre-ranking padj cutoff and no enrichr/web-service or R detour. Universe, ranking metric, NES/FDR/leading-edge reporting and leading-edge collapsing of redundant inflammatory hallmarks are all specified, and the report block covers tool versions, thresholds, tested and significant gene counts, and design caveats. Upstream-only criteria are handled by deferral rather than by analysis: independent filtering and Cook's-outlier NAs are recognised, and the sample_01 shallow-library concern is carried forward as an inherited limitation, but there is no sample-level QC (PCA, distances, library sizes) and no discussion of size-factor normalization or the design formula beyond noting the contrast is the one supplied, which is defensible here but leaves those criteria only partially evidenced. Tie-handling in the ranking is the one small gap; the WikiPathways/GO BP second pass is correctly framed as supplementary with separate FDR families.
